The Ultimate Luxury Private Couples Therapy Retreat Escape

Discover the Alive Relationship Renewal Retreat Program; truly one of a kind. More budget-friendly than a divorce, this retreat offers troubled couples a chance revitalise your relationship. Whether you seek honest discussions through our impactful therapy and coaching or wish to reconnect while enjoying a transformative wellness journey, our personalised couples retreats are designed to expedite the healing process while inspiring personal growth for every individual involved in the relationship. With individualised Fast Track Therapy set in breathtaking surroundings, our approach empowers each partner to become their best selves and fosters relationship healing. Couples achieve genuine, lasting results without juggling multiple therapists, allowing them to solely focus on their relationship and personal development issues in all areas of life. Embrace tranquility in your own private paradise, away from daily pressures, and work through the causes of your challenges while gaining powerful tools for a fulfilling future together. Our 5-star Relationship Help Retreats, hosted by a dedicated team of top international experts, present a unique opportunity to reset and recreate every aspect of your life and relationship. Regardless of the challenges you face, we assemble a tailored team to your transformation in complete confidentiality. WE DELIVER RESULTS IN WEEKS, NOT MONTHS—AND THEY ENDURE A LIFETIME.

WE DON'T JUST HEAL RELATIONSHIPS; WE TRANSFORM LIVES. Every couple is distinct, often grappling with issues like disconnection, infidelity, or overwhelming responsibilities. Our empowered approach enables clients to achieve rapid results in a nurturing environment using effective skills and tools. With our world-class experts in health, life, mental health, and relationships, you'll experience a life-changing program in privacy, fully supported on your journey to transformation. Leave your responsibilities behind and embrace total peace with a tailored holistic wellness and transformation team, ready to lighten your load and help you reconnect with your self.

Our Relationship Transformation Philosophy
We Work With All Types Of Couples
At Alive we support a wide range of couples and families without judgement or restriction.

We work with married couples, long term partners, couples preparing for marriage and couples from different cultural, faith and personal backgrounds. We also support LGBTQ+ couples, families with children and couples navigating major life changes.

Some couples come to reconnect and rebuild their relationship. Others come seeking clarity about their future. In some cases we support couples who are choosing to separate and want to do so with peace, respect and emotional maturity.
We Focus On The Individual First
Unlike traditional couples therapy which focuses only on the relationship itself, our philosophy is that relationships improve when individuals improve.
When a person's health, habits, emotional wellbeing, values or life direction are out of alignment, the relationship often begins to suffer.

For this reason our program begins with each individual. Through a holistic assessment we look at the areas of life that are influencing how each person shows up in the relationship, including health, mindset, identity, purpose and communication.
As each person gains clarity about themselves and the life they want to live, understanding between partners grows and many relationship conflicts begin to dissolve.
Transformation Instead Of Endless Therapy
Rather than spending months analysing problems, our focus is on real change.
Each person is supported to become the strongest and most aligned version of themselves while learning practical tools for communication, understanding and emotional maturity.
As individuals grow, couples begin to rebuild respect, understanding and a shared vision for their future.
For some couples this leads to reconnection and a stronger partnership. For others it brings the clarity to separate with peace and respect.
Either way, the outcome is guided by honesty, integrity and personal growth.

Holistic Assessment

You don't need clinical labels & boring therapy that makes you both feel worse. You need one team to complete a thorough 360 degree view of your life, health, past, feelings, relationship and more. Rarely is those done correctly if at all. After this assessment the team cultivates a plan for action, healing & transformation that works.
Find The Root Cause

What you believe is the cause of the relationship 'crash' rarely is. And it can seem that there are so many issues to deal with. Using the butterfly effect we target the true core issues that are truly driving the problems & support the whole person & couple to heal through powerful education & real tools with full team support.
gain real understanding

You both can't heal what you don't understand. We get to the real core of the issues from both sides and give you both a fast and deep understanding and perspective of each other. This gives you both the power then to be heard, seen and understood with full support.
All love is born out of understanding ad ay issues ca be healed when you are given the gift of perspective.
individual transformation

We look at you both as individuals and what is truly missing within your own self and life. When we heal the individual issues the relationship becomes workable quickly. We stop expecting the other person to heal, help, fix or change and instead each of you works to become the greatest version of yourself so that you are bringing greatness into the relationship.
BOOK A CALL TO GET ANSWERS
Heal Emotionally & Transform Your CONNECTION
Release The
Past

Many of our clients have spent months or years in therapy disempowered by spending time digging through the past & rehashing their pain. We acknowledge awareness of your past hurts but we know that healing happens in the present taking action with real tools to release resentment and radically forgive.
COMMUNICATE WITH EASE

Be heard, seen and understood and learn the art of clear communication to be able to have your needs met. You will both master deep selfless understanding, awareness of the others needs ad how to communicate easily and respectfully.
EMOTIONAL CALM

The inner peace tools & practices you learn to calm the mind, deal with emotion and change your behaviour on the spot help you build an unbreakable relationship with yourself. You will become the most present, calm and confident version of yourself now and always and this supports the relationship is outstanding ways.
Eradicate Your Stress

We ensure that whatever is driving your stress internally or externally is dealt with fast so that your own stress isn't impacting the relationship in unhealthy ways. We take practical steps to eliminate stress in your lives & create a life moving forward that supports you for the long term to thrive.
BOOK A CALL TO EXPERIENCE OUR THERAPY
Ignite Your Love of Life, Self & each other
The Power of Forgiveness
Many of our clients are holding themselves or others hostage with resentment. Forgiveness & understanding becomes the gateway to make space for the life you truly want.
Be The Greatest Self

You are not who you think you are. If you have lost your sense of self and direction - now is the time to revamp your own identity ad step into greatness. Now you step into who you really are & craft a life as your greatest self being authentically you without fear and ignite your own passion for life and what you bring to the relationship.
Create A Life You Love

You design a powerful vision for your life with the habits in place to live as the best version of you. You then both together create a new vision moving forward for all areas of your life. You live life by design not by default ad you both create a plan for life that you will love.
REPAIR & RECONNECT

Create deep connection, understanding, boundaries and communication to form the bonds & support you both desire and deserve. As you both get on the same page & both show as your greatest self the relationship reconnection becomes easy & the attraction & spark returns naturally.

blocks.text: 360 Degree Holistic Team

We start with a complete picture of your wellbeing understanding the whole person — physical, emotional, mental, relational, and lifestyle. Our detailed assessments help us tailor a program that meets your unique needs and ensures your retreat delivers the transformation you’re seeking.
Mind Tools For Stress Rlease

Discover inner calm and clarity through proven practices like mindfulness, meditation, breathwork, and deep relaxation. These tools help you recenter during life’s challenges and cultivate a long-lasting sense of peace and self-awareness.
Healing Therapies

Your one on one healing sessions help you emotionally release what you are holding onto and reset hidden patterns that are driving the unconscious behaviours that cause burn out, exhaustion and overwhelm. Work with healers, kinesiologists, somatic breathwork practitioners that suit you personally to release the old and welcome the new.
Health & Energy Transformation

From customised nutrition and detox plans, natural medicine, cleansing, biohacking including IV and ozone therapy, we focus on restoring balance across your whole body. The result is renewed energy, deeper sleep, and a vibrant sense of wellness that lasts long beyond your retreat.
De Stress Your Life

We equip you with practical strategies in our powerful Alive Coaching Workshops to create balance in everyday life — from reshaping habits and schedules to learning how to prioritise your wellbeing. Leave with a toolkit to live calmer, clearer, and more productive, without slipping back into stress cycles.
Spa, Massage & Relaxation

With healing spa and massage sessions you experience hands on nurturing and stress release. Time to rest and reflect daily in the privacy of your own luxury beachfront pool villa or surrounding areas for deep reflection and peace.
Fitness & Movement

Movement becomes joyful again with activities designed to meet you where you are. From yoga therapy and functional fitness classes to guided hikes and adventures in nature, our fitness approach is about feeling strong, energised, and alive in your own body.
Inspiring Therapy

Through private sessions with our executive level life and wellness coaches or holistic counsellors, hypnotherapists, and holistic healers, you’ll experience powerful insights and breakthroughs. Our focus is forward-looking — helping you release old patterns and step fully into the greatest version of yourself.
New Purpose & Life Direction

Clarity creates momentum. With expert guidance, you’ll rediscover your passions, define your goals, and design an inspiring plan for your next chapter. Supported by our ongoing aftercare, you’ll leave not just with insight, but with motivation and a clear path forward.
